She claims abrupt loss of infusion can worsen motor weakness, ventilation and sometimes rhythm; personally saw one patient die after interruption despite restart, BUT neither causal proof nor mechanism established. The Kusa hospital's separate earlier drug lab preliminary showed peptide-containing organic fraction, which is consistent but not direct matched sample nor proof same formula.

Mei says adolescent patient designated 'реципиент шесть', about16, brought to building four days before, without real name. Profound generalized skeletal muscle weakness: cannot sit or lift hands; weak swallowing/cough reflex, shallow inspiratory chest movement requiring assisted ventilation. Eyes follow spoken voice, pupils responsive, no seizures observed, sensation incompletely tested. No temperature rise recorded. Her last known supported readings around20:45: HR~92/min, SpO2~96% ON respiratory support, not evidence of normal intrinsic ventilation. Low muscle tone, small older SYMMETRIC forearm scars of unexplained origin. Her testimony rather than Shiki direct exam, patient remains unopened/unexamined.

Mei describes continuous IV infusion through venous line, compressor assisted ventilation, monitor saturation/pulse/circuit pressure/volume, verify lines and skin and dehydration, change respiratory assistance as needed, not authorized independently change stabilizer concentration. She has NOT personally performed transplant, cell injection or genetic manipulation after boy arrival, did not see primary chart; allegedly chart calls condition 'после соматической интеграции донорского клеточного материала' and sometimes 'поддержание приобретённой функции'. She knows no donor tissue identity, genetic test, measured acquired function, or confirmed genome change. 'Генетическая ассимиляция' HYPOTHESIS remains unproven; mechanistic categories transplant vs engraftment vs heritable cell integration distinct.

Independent captain Hayase Nori emerges with equipment operation log from inside defunct Research Building #3; four pages are missing, but maintenance logs of breathing pressure/IV/connection match Mei's general technical statements. Nori has called medical team with portable breathing assistance, keeps unknown compressor and container running, no opened case or actual transplant. Nori relays authenticated Kusa SOUTH PATROL REPORT: unmarked wagon was found abandoned without horses at old river sluice, escorts gone, TWO long cases visible aboard, some machine audible. Patrol did NOT OPEN cases and patient number/viability not confirmed. Kusa patrol already guards wagon and additional group is coming. Mei alarmed, fears autonomous power not infinite; duration unknown, not fixed death clock. Nori intends protect all patients and neither assigns Shiki pursuit nor assumes cargo alive.
